newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power dips on cool weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power dips on cool weather.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. dipped Friday on cool weather moving into the region and expected returns of several nuclear power plants from refueling, market sources said.
"It's a little weaker. Not a lot is getting done," said one Houston trader.
"The bids and offers are coming down," echoed another trader.
Temperatures in the Mid-Atlantic were forecast to be five to 10 Fahrenheits below normal this weekend, but to warm slightly by middle of next week, Weather Services Corp said.

Three nuclear power units, with combined capacity totaling more than 2,500 megawatts (MW), in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool were scheduled to resume operation from autumn refueling beginning this weekend: Pennsylvania Power & Light Co's 1,090 MW Susquehanna 1 in Berwick, Pa.; Duquesne Light Co's 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 in Shippingport, Pa. and GPU Nuclear's 610 MW Oyster Creek in Forked River, N.J.
Moreover, PECO Energy Co's 1,100 MW Peach Bottom 2 nuclear unit in Delta, Pa., restarted late Thursday after tripping off line Tuesday due to an electrical problem with its turbine generator.

Firm, peak PJM electricity for Saturday delivery was discussed near $21.50; Sunday $18.00-$19.50 and Monday $22.50-$23.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), compared with Thursday's $23.00-$24.50 for Friday delivery.
Firm, peak PJM power for the five business days next eek was assessed at $22.25-$23.25.
November PJM electricity edged down to $22.75-$23.00 from Thursday's $23.00-$23.50.
December PJM power finished at $27.00-$27.60, wider than a quote of $27.00-$27.45 on Thursday.
PJM values in 1997 were generally higher in thin talk.
January/February 1997 PJM deliveries were quoted at $31.25-$31.75, compared with Thursday's $31.00-$31.60.
First-quarter 1997 PJM was pegged at $29.00-29.20, up from Thursday's $28.90-$29.10 range.
Second-quarter 1997 PJM electricity was valued at $21.75-$21.85, narrower than $21.75-$22.25 on Thursday.
July/August 1997 PJM deliveries were still quoted at $31.00-$31.35, flat from Thursday.
